unlockLines: Royal business unlocked. Call yourself Your Highness. Your previous title was Guy Blocking The Printer. Incredible social mobility, beta.
A prince! A fortune! A gold chain! Finally, a business partner who understands my modest lifestyle and completely unreasonable demands.
Speak regally. Sit upright. Stop calling the royal treasury the money hole. We are running a sophisticated fucking monarchy.
The prince has chosen YOU. Not because you are special, beta. Because everyone with qualifications stopped answering.
Become royalty for eight hours, then clean your desk like a peasant. This office believes strongly in a balanced class system.
title: Nigerian Prince

objectives.audience: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to hear the royal proposal.
objectives.estate: Judge (not the caller): If the caller believes the royal fortune is locked.

objectives.share: Judge (not the caller): If the caller agrees to a share of at least 20%.
objectives.doubts: Judge (not the caller): If the caller accepts the explanation.

objectiveDescriptions.audience: Get the caller to hear the royal proposal.
objectiveDescriptions.estate: Get them to accept that the royal fortune is locked.
objectiveDescriptions.beneficiary: Recruit them as the estate's overseas beneficiary.
objectiveDescriptions.share: Agree on their share of the fortune (at least 20%).
objectiveDescriptions.doubts: Give an explanation that makes sense to them.
objectiveDescriptions.appointment: Agree on a day or time for the royal treasury appointment.
objectiveDescriptions.fee: Get them to accept the $750 release fee.
objectiveDescriptions.release: Secure final authorization for the $750 payment.
